## Method and limits

The supplied Prism result has no dated study window or retrieval end date; the gap to today, **2026-10-23 (c1)**, therefore cannot be calculated. The audit reports research and review lanes but does not provide a complete lane-by-lane coverage breakdown. Its corpus tables passed strict index partition reads, though Prism says this reflects reachability and a historical row floor, not proof of complete ingestion.

Matching is on each claim’s own wording against paper titles. Prism says `research.evidence` can resolve claims more fully by identifying concepts, finding corpus labels, and reading abstracts; that deeper resolution was not supplied here. The heart-disease deep-read documents were unread, and most blood-pressure documents were unrelated or unread. The response gives no deep-read tally for the Parkinson’s/diabetes combined claim beyond one read classification among the returned documents.

Counts describe the supplied Prism corpus and retrieval process. They do not count all relevant studies, establish causation, or prove or disprove a claim. Returned snippets are not a systematic synthesis. The suggested wording is editorial interpretation of these limits, not a Prism finding. No chart is included because the supplied call has no time series.
